unit.why: A single narrative about the Besht travelling with a thirsty disciple in the desert and water appearing through divine providence, framed as a lesson on faith (emunah).

stories.start_quote: ופעם אחת נסע מרן הק׳ אור ישראל
stories.end_quote: צפה השגחהו יתברך ברגע של בריאת עולם
stories.summary_en: While travelling with the Besht through a waterless wasteland, a disciple nearly dies of thirst. The Besht asks whether he believes God foresaw his need at Creation. Once the disciple affirms his faith, they meet a gentile carrying water sent by his deranged lord, and the Besht points to divine providence.

tags.why: The Besht's journey with a disciple frames the whole story
